source: Explicit diagnostic pytest run through actual HTTP endpoints and services
stock_sql:
SELECT ingredients.id, ingredients.storage_box_id, ingredients.name, ingredients.quantity, ingredients.unit, ingredients.expiry_date, ingredients.expiry_source, storage_boxes.id AS id_1, storage_boxes.refrigerator_id, storage_boxes.name AS name_1, storage_boxes.type, storage_boxes.display_order, refrigerators.id AS id_2, refrigerators.name AS name_2, refrigerators.created_at 
FROM ingredients JOIN storage_boxes ON ingredients.storage_box_id = storage_boxes.id JOIN refrigerators ON storage_boxes.refrigerator_id = refrigerators.id 
WHERE refrigerators.id IN ($1::INTEGER) AND ingredients.id IN ($2::INTEGER, $3::INTEGER) ORDER BY ingredients.id FOR UPDATE OF ingredients, storage_boxes

dml: INSERT INTO ingredients (storage_box_id, name, quantity, unit, expiry_date, expiry_source) VALUES ($1::INTEGER, $2::VARCHAR, $3::FLOAT, $4::VARCHAR, $5::DATE, $6::VARCHAR) RETURNING ingredients.id
UPDATE ingredients SET quantity=$1::FLOAT WHERE ingredients.id = $2::INTEGER

INSERT INTO ingredient_logs (user_id, refrigerator_id, refrigerator_name, ingredient_id, action_type, ingredient_name, quantity, unit, expiry_date, expiry_source, memo, created_at) VALUES ($1::INTEGER, $2::INTEGER, $3::VARCHAR, $4::INTEGER, $5::actiontype, $6::VARCHAR, $7::FLOAT, $8::VARCHAR, $9::DATE, $10::VARCHAR, $11::VARCHAR, $12::TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE) RETURNING ingredient_logs.id
